Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Manoj Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the
complainant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2.  In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that on 25.06.2023, when the daughter of the informant was alone, the applicant came and took her by use of force to agricultural field and after stating that he has come from Balia, he committed the offence and certain photograph was also made viral.
3. In the light of the said allegation, the counsel for the applicant argues that the FIR was lodged on 04.08.2023 after about more than one and half months without there being any explanation.

1 statements under Section 161 & 164 Cr.P.C. corroborated the allegation in the FIR.

It is further argued that Balia, where the applicant resides is at a distance of 600 Kms from the place of the incident and it is highly improbable that a person would come to commit the offence from a distance of 600 Kms.
The medical on record does not corroborate any of the incident.
The tentative age of the victim is around 16 years 6 months, although the process of determination of correct age has not been followed.
4. Learned A.G.A. as well as the counsel for the complainant opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the delay in lodging the FIR and the improbability of the allegation, a case for bail is made out particularly when the applicant is in custody since 09.08.2023 having no criminal history.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Mukesh Chauhan be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 46 of 2023, under Sections 376, 457, 506 IPC and Section 67, 67-A, 67-B IT Act and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Padhhuwa, District Kheri, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/-
each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
